[package]
authors = ["Junfeng Liu <china.liujunfeng@gmail.com>", "Emulator <emulator@hotmail.it>"]
categories = ["text-processing"]
description = "A Rust library for PDF document manipulation."
documentation = "https://docs.rs/crate/lopdf/"
edition = "2024"
homepage = "https://github.com/J-F-Liu/lopdf"
keywords = ["pdf", "editing", "manipulation", "merge"]
license = "MIT"
name = "lopdf"
readme = "README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/J-F-Liu/lopdf.git"
version = "0.44.0"
rust-version = "1.88"
exclude = ["/benches", "/assets", "/.chglog", "/.vscode", "/.github"]

[dependencies]
aes = "0.9"
bitflags = "2.13"
cbc = "0.2"
ecb = "0.2"
encoding_rs = "0.8"
flate2 = "1.1"
indexmap = "2.14"
itoa = "1.0"
getrandom = "0.4"
log = "0.4"
md-5 = "0.11"
nom = "8.0"
rangemap = "1.7"
sha2 = "0.11"
stringprep = "0.1.5"
thiserror = "2.0"
weezl = "0.2"

[dependencies.chrono]
version = "0.4"
optional = true
default-features = false
features = ["std"]

[dependencies.image]
version = "0.25"
optional = true

[dependencies.jiff]
version = "0.2"
optional = true

[dependencies.rand]
version = "0.10"

[dependencies.rayon]
version = "1.12"
optional = true

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0"
features = ["derive"]
optional = true

[dependencies.time]
version = "0.3"
features = ["formatting", "parsing"]
optional = true

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["fs", "io-util"]
optional = true

[dependencies.skrifa]
version = "0.45.1"
optional = true

[dev-dependencies]
env_logger = "0.11"
flate2 = "1.1"
serde_json = "1.0"
shellexpand = "3.1"
tempfile = "3.27"
wasm-bindgen-test = "0.3"

[dev-dependencies.clap]
version = "4.6"
features = ["derive"]

[target."cfg(not(target_family=\"wasm\"))".dev-dependencies]
criterion = "0.8"

[features]
async = ["tokio/rt-multi-thread", "tokio/macros"]
chrono = ["dep:chrono"]
chrono-clock = ["chrono", "chrono/clock"]
default = ["chrono-clock", "rayon"]
embed_image = ["image"]
font_embedding = ["dep:skrifa"]
jiff = ["dep:jiff"]
wasm_js = ["getrandom/wasm_js"]
serde = ["dep:serde"]
time = ["dep:time"]

[[example]]
name = "extract_toc"
required-features = ["serde"]

[[example]]
name = "extract_text"
required-features = ["serde"]

[[example]]
name = "print_annotations"

[[example]]
name = "rotate"

[[bench]]
name = "datetime"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "parse"
harness = false

[badges.travis-ci]
repository = "J-F-Liu/lopdf"
